name: Jorge Jesus
scopeNote: Two counted spells: Benfica first spell (2009-06-17 to June 2015: three Primeira Ligas, 10 trophies in six years, two Europa League finals) and Flamengo (signed 2019-06-01, left 2020-07-17: Libertadores and Brasileirao 2019, Recopa, Supercopa, Carioca 2020). Style term used by sources: 4-4-2 (often 4-1-3-2 / 4-2-3-1), vertical, intense, high pressing with counter-press; Coaches' Voice says he was influenced by Cruyff; the 'tactical genius / possession' label is partly wrong for Flamengo, where Wyscout/Hudl calls the attack 'uprightness' (verticality) rather than long possession. Benfica 2009-15 tactical evidence in the digests is thin and mostly retrospective (Coaches' Voice 2020) plus a 2013 fan column on set pieces and Record 2014 on youth; Flamengo coverage is richer. Benfica start date 2009-06-17 comes only from a search summary (Wikipedia), not read on a page; the end date is only known as June 2015 (profilePeriod end is the Flamengo exit, 2020-07-17, given in the Record and DN pages). Excluded spells: see spellsExcluded. Spell dates marked partial (month or year only) for excluded spells and the Benfica 2015 exit are not confirmed to the day; the statedView[0] date is the article date, the quote itself is undated.

spellsCounted.reason: Three Primeira Ligas, 10 trophies in six years, two Europa League finals, recognisable 4-4-2 vertical/intense style; exact departure day to Sporting not confirmed (June 2015).
Libertadores and Brasileirao 2019, Recopa, Supercopa, Carioca 2020; widely documented tactical identity; start is the signing date per DN, first match 2019-07-10; end is the club statement date.

spellsExcluded.reason: Short and no major titles; period not researched (Taca da Liga 2008/09 only), tactical coverage thin. Dates from memory, not verified.
No league title, style largely a continuation of Benfica (Coaches' Voice); not needed to define the profile. Coaches' Voice Sporting paragraphs were not used as evidence.
Brief spell before Flamengo, little tactical coverage.
Sacked after poor results, no title; the 2020-08 BTV interview is used only as a statedView (any date), not as in-period evidence.
No title, outside the defining period; the TFA analysis is used only for its Flamengo statistic.
Different league and squad; Trivela 2025 piece used only as retrospective about the Flamengo 2019 press, labelled so.

openQuestions: Marking: Hudl/Wyscout (2019-09) says Flamengo defended with zonal marking in the sector and limited pursuits, while Coaches' Voice (2020) says Flamengo had a desire to mark man-for-man and Trivela (2025, retrospective) describes individual matching (encaixes) in the press: unresolved whether the defence was zonal with man-oriented pressing.

Set pieces: the 2013 Bola na Rede column says Jesus used zonal marking on defensive set pieces from 2009 and suggested a mixed model; it is a fan column (no coach confirmation). Flamengo set-piece evidence not found.
Benfica start date 2009-06-17 comes from a search summary quoting Wikipedia, not read on a page; the day Jesus left Benfica (June 2015) is not confirmed.
Braga 2008/09 dates are from memory and not verified.

Benfica 2009-15 pressing, build-up and transitions rest only on Coaches' Voice 2020 retrospective; a contemporaneous analysis (e.g. Benfica vs Chelsea 2013 final or Spielverlagerung) is still missing.

TFA (2022) describes a Benfica build-up and press 'against Arsenal'; this is probably the 2020/21 Europa League tie (second Benfica spell, excluded) so it was not used as evidence for Benfica 2009-15.

Squad-building: Goal (2019) and Record (2014) say Jesus rarely used academy players, but Jesus himself (2020 BTV) argues no team lives off its academy; Bernardo Silva (2019) says he was not wanted in 2013/14. Press label 'does not bet on youth' is common but is partly narrative.
People-management at Flamengo rests on a Goal Brasil piece before his first match (2019-07-10) and a 2025 Trivela comparison; no player testimonies from within the period were read.

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: He typically favours a 4-4-2 or four-diamond-two formation, but continues to experiment with a 4-2-3-1

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: in each system his goalkeeper adopts an advanced position in a team that builds possession from the back and attempts to maintain possession by using changes of pace and switches of play

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: The extent to which Benfica were accustomed to both having a significant portion of possession and using it to attack

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: they also prioritised defending with a compact mid-block if they couldn't make immediate regains upon conceding that possession. Their full-backs operated in line with their central midfielders to contribute to doing so, and opposing attacks were often delayed in the middle third

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: the wingers outside of Benfica's front two consistently attacked infield to narrow positions to deliver crosses (...) Even though their full-backs therefore regularly had space to attack into, they didn't necessarily do so because their responsibility was often to help those central midfielders to defend

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: They pressed with intensity, and often in advanced positions, depending on the demands of the relevant match.

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Similarly consistent was their compact defensive structure (above), mid-block, desire to mark man-for-man, and their quick recoveries into their defensive shape.

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: During defensive phases Flamengo were encouraged to make quick transitions. (...) They were regardless less consistent in their attempts to pressure opponents into turnovers when they were defending against counter-attacks, owing to their struggles to limit spaces in those circumstances.

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: full-backs Rafinha and Filipe Luís were similarly encouraged to attack (above), and did so in the knowledge that the dynamic Willian Arão would offer defensive protection from central midfield.

sources.title: Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Jesús has long acknowledged the extent to which the late, great Johan Cruyff influenced him. He demands a clear identity, with an intense, attacking game built on a collective approach, and which attempts to create overloads when his team is attacking.

sources.title: How Jorge Jesus turned Flamengo into a title contender (Hudl/Wyscout)
sources.evidence: Jorge Jesus became known for using 4-1-3-2, but he only used it in the first games in Brazil. The formation most used by Flamengo is 4-4-2, with two players more aligned towards the centre, two wingers with the freedom to move towards the centre, and total mobility of the front pair made up of Bruno Henrique and Gabigol.

sources.title: How Jorge Jesus turned Flamengo into a title contender (Hudl/Wyscout)
sources.evidence: The word that best defines Flamengo’s attack under Jorge Jesus is uprightness. No matter how much it dominates ball possession in its matches, it’s not a team for long possession and constant passes.

sources.title: How Jorge Jesus turned Flamengo into a title contender (Hudl/Wyscout)
sources.evidence: Whatever the tactical scheme adopted, Flamengo uses a goal kick play with three players aligned initially. Willian Arão infiltrates the centre backs and frees up Rafinha and Filipe Luís.

sources.title: How Jorge Jesus turned Flamengo into a title contender (Hudl/Wyscout)
sources.evidence: As for defensive organisation, Flamengo uses zonal marking in the sector and some pursuits. But they’re not long. It’s unusual to see one of the wingers of the Rubro-Negro moving far from their area of operation to follow an opposing player.

sources.title: How Jorge Jesus turned Flamengo into a title contender (Hudl/Wyscout)
sources.evidence: Flamengo positions itself with very close lines between the defence and midfield, it approaches its adversary very intensively when the time comes to attacks, and counts on the active participation of the strikers.

sources.title: How Jorge Jesus turned Flamengo into a title contender (Hudl/Wyscout)
sources.evidence: Flamengo has scored a lot of goals from counter-attacks under Jorge Jesus. (...) For defensive transitions, the idea the “Mister” has is to provide immediate intensity to get the ball back. The “lose, put pressure on” tactic is increasingly being executed in a more coordinated manner by the team.

sources.title: How Jorge Jesus turned Flamengo into a title contender (Hudl/Wyscout)
sources.evidence: Filipe Luís and Rafinha are coordinating wingers. Several times, they occupy the flanks according to the ideas of Jorge Jesus, dictating the rhythm of the team with all their experience and the high level they’ve achieved in their careers.

sources.title: How Jorge Jesus turned Flamengo into a title contender (Hudl/Wyscout)
sources.evidence: During the first few games, there was often a certain imbalance because of this extreme freedom Jorge Jesus was giving to his more advanced players.

sources.title: How Jorge Jesus turned Flamengo into a title contender (Hudl/Wyscout)
sources.evidence: Gabigol and Bruno Henrique are two players who are cut out for this kind of play. De Arrascaeta has an excellent perception of the last metres of the pitch.

sources.title: Analise tatica: As semelhancas e diferencas de Jorge Jesus e Ancelotti (Trivela)
sources.evidence: o Flamengo supervencedor de 2019 ficou tão conhecido pela dedicação e um perde pressiona instantâneo. Ao pressionar também no 4-4-2, os jogadores realizam encaixes individuais: os dois atacantes vão nos zagueiros, os pontas nos laterais e assim por diante.

sources.title: Analise tatica: As semelhancas e diferencas de Jorge Jesus e Ancelotti (Trivela)
sources.evidence: os times de Jesus são ótimos em atacar de forma vertical com as ultrapassagens já citadas. Pode ser um contra-ataque ou após superar uma pressão alta adversária.

sources.title: Analise tatica: As semelhancas e diferencas de Jorge Jesus e Ancelotti (Trivela)
sources.evidence: o ponta ou o lateral do outro lado, costuma ficar bem aberto, colado na linha lateral (a chamada “amplitude”), para ser uma opção de inversão de bola.

sources.title: Analise tatica: As semelhancas e diferencas de Jorge Jesus e Ancelotti (Trivela)
sources.evidence: Após superar a primeira linha de pressão, as equipes do técnico português apostavam em aglomerar vários jogadores no setor da bola.

sources.title: Pressoes rubro-negras (Tribuna de Minas)
sources.evidence: Vamos tentar marcar sob pressão, pois é um time que não gosta muito disso. E o Jorge pediu bastante intensidade na marcação. Todos vão poder ver que vamos correr um pouco mais

sources.title: A parte tatica de Jorge Jesus e o que esperar do novo Flamengo (Goal Brasil)
sources.evidence: No Benfica, auge da carreira, o estilo organizado e ofensivo ganhou fama. Por conta disso, é possível esperar que Jorge utilize bastante o elenco. Ao contrário de outros, não é de aproveitar com frequência os jovens da base.

sources.title: A parte tatica de Jorge Jesus e o que esperar do novo Flamengo (Goal Brasil)
sources.evidence: Por conta disso, gosta bastante de jogar pelos lados. Enfileirou títulos desta maneira no Benfica. (...) Muitas jogadas são criadas a partir dos corredores. Encurta bastante o campo de ação e visa a progressão vertical

sources.title: A parte tatica de Jorge Jesus e o que esperar do novo Flamengo (Goal Brasil)
sources.evidence: Quase sempre são eles ou algum meia mais recuado quem conduzem a saída, orientandos para que opções de passes sejam oferecidas em torno de quem tem a bola. Desta maneira, além de manter a posse, sobe em bloco.

sources.title: Exigente, detalhista e zero paizao (Goal Brasil)
sources.evidence: Para ele, o time precisa ser bem compactado independente da formação que coloca em campo. Por isso, a pressão em linhas altas é uma das exigencias do treinador, que espera seus atletas pessionando a saída de bola e não deixando o Furacão respirar.

sources.title: Exigente, detalhista e zero paizao (Goal Brasil)
sources.evidence: O treinador é "bruto" e deixa claro que está trabalhando com homens e não meninos. Ele foge da característica de paizão e encarna o "patrão" com nível de exigência alto e sem "carinho", o que tem sido absorvido de forma positiva pelos atletas.

sources.title: Desmistificar o problema (Bola na Rede)
sources.evidence: Desde que chegou ao Benfica, em 2009, Jorge Jesus tratou de implementar um modelo defensivo de bolas paradas assente na marcação à zona. Em cada livre ou canto os jogadores constroem uma espécie de linha à frente do guarda-redes e esperam que a bola venha para a atacarem. Não há qualquer marcação individual.

sources.title: Formacao com Jesus so rendeu 15 milhoes as aguias (Record)
sources.evidence: Em pouco mais de cinco anos à frente do Benfica, Jorge Jesus tem lançado pontualmente jogadores da cantera do Seixal, mas a grande maioria deles não só não conseguiu agarrar um lugar, como já abandonou o clube. Roderick Miranda, David Simão, Miguel Vítor, Miguel Rosa, Luís Martins e Romeu Ribeiro estrearam-se todos pelas mãos de Jesus

sources.title: Formacao com Jesus so rendeu 15 milhoes as aguias (Record)
sources.evidence: A única exceção é mesmo André Gomes. O jovem médio natural de Gaia até só mereceu maior aposta de Jesus na reta final de 2013/2014

sources.title: Bernardo Silva: Quando cheguei a equipa principal do Benfica descobri que Jorge Jesus nao me queria (Record)
sources.evidence: Mas o treinador não contava comigo. Meteu-me a lateral esquerdo na pré-época, joguei apenas uma vez na Liga e no final da temporada disse-me que queria que voltasse à equipa B por mais um ano.

sources.title: Jorge Jesus tem mais titulos do que derrotas no Flamengo (Diario de Noticias)
sources.evidence: o fato de estarmos em vantagem e sabermos que era mais importante defender o objetivo, fizemos um jogo mais pausado, mais controlado

sources.title: Jorge Jesus tem mais titulos do que derrotas no Flamengo (Diario de Noticias)
sources.evidence: Cada vez somos uma equipa mais difícil de sofrer golo. Nós defendemos melhor, a equipa sabe o que fazer na organização defensiva. Joga sempre no limite, por isso há um desgaste, mas hoje felizmente há equipas no Brasil que jogam assim. É o futebol moderno

sources.title: Jorge Jesus tem mais titulos do que derrotas no Flamengo (Diario de Noticias)
sources.evidence: Melhorar tem que melhorar, a equipa não atingiu os níveis do ano passado. Todos os meus quatro atacantes não estão no nível do ano passado

sources.title: Jorge Jesus tem mais titulos do que derrotas no Flamengo (Diario de Noticias)
sources.evidence: Jesus assinou pelos brasileiros em 01 de junho de 2019.

sources.title: Flamengo confirma saida de Jorge Jesus (Record)
sources.evidence: Nos 13 meses que Jorge Jesus dirigiu nosso time de futebol profissional, o Flamengo teve uma performance espetacular, conquistando a Copa Libertadores (2019), o Campeonato Brasileiro (2019), a Supercopa do Brasil (2020), a Recopa Sul-Americana (2020), a Taça Guanabara (2020) e, na última quarta-feira (15), o Campeonato Carioca (2020).

sources.title: Jorge Jesus Tactics At Fenerbahce 2022/2023 (Total Football Analysis)
sources.evidence: Throughout his time with Flamengo, Jorge Jesus used a 4-2-3-1 formation 45% of the time.

statedView.quote: It’s not enough just to win a match; you also have to entertain
statedView.source: Coaches' Voice, Coach Watch: Jorge Jesus (2020-11-03), 'Jesús once said'

statedView.quote: Todos os clubes têm de cada vez mais evoluir e preocupar-se com a formação porque é uma das formas de criar ativos, no presente e no futuro, mas isso não dá sustento desportivo aos objetivos que tens numa equipa. Não existe nenhuma equipa do mundo que viva da sua formação
statedView.source: BTV interview, reported by Renascenca (rr.pt); second Benfica spell, excluded from evidence

statedView.quote: Se eu estivesse a contratar um jogador para o imediato, havia jogadores com mais experiência como o Cebolinha ou o Dudu. São jogadores dentro dessas características. O Pedrinho é um jogador jovem com talento, para ser trabalhado, ao contrário do Cebolinha que está feito.
Os mind games que, quando eu saí, se colocavam muitas vezes entre treinadores, não o vou fazer. Isso não ajuda a ganhar jogos e não valoriza o futebol

Melhorar tem que melhorar, a equipa não atingiu os níveis do ano passado. (...) Cada vez somos uma equipa mais difícil de sofrer golo. Nós defendemos melhor, a equipa sabe o que fazer na organização defensiva.
statedView.source: FlaTV post-match interview after Carioca final, reported by Diario de Noticias (2020-07-16)

statedView.quote: Faltava só este troféu, principalmente a mim, que nunca ganhei um Estadual.
statedView.source: FlaTV post-match interview, reported by Diario de Noticias (2020-07-16)

influences: Johan Cruyff (per Coaches' Voice: 'long acknowledged' his influence)

confidence.reason: Flamengo 2019/20 has a tier A and two tier B sources that agree on 4-4-2, vertical play and intense press, but disagree on zonal vs man marking; Benfica 2009-15 relies on a Coaches' Voice retrospective, a fan column and Record 2014; people-management and Flamengo set-pieces are thin.
